items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: Black Benning used to tie them with rope, you know. Oh, Black Benning.

ctx.x: Is it true that they used to lock the wheels of the wagons together sometimes?

Black Benning used to tie them with rope, you know. Oh, Black Benning. They wouldn't lock them, they'd lock them. They'd take a rope. Oh, rope. The other guy would try to get away from them and drag along with them. That's cool.
In fact, wasn't that the way you got hold of Joe Oliver?
